attempts.rationale: The llm package imports httpx but does not declare it as a dependency. With openai 3.0.0, httpx is no longer a transitive dependency, so we must declare it explicitly to avoid ImportError. This also allows the llm package to continue using httpx for any custom HTTP client needs, ensuring compatibility with the existing pytest_httpx mocks.

Adding an upper bound on openai prevents the 3.0.0 release that switched to HTTPX2, which breaks the existing httpx-based test mocks. This restores the pre‑release behavior without requiring test modifications.
